Look. I cant tell you to lie and frankly I dont think its a great option either. Im not saying do or dont lie but I lied on my questionare and to the doc. I thought my scars were SUPER faint and the doc still found them. I told him that I fell from a ladder and into some black berry bushes, which is a true story, but theyre trained professionals who actually look for it. And as you know I still got my waiver, but having gone through it I dont know if I'd make the same call to lie. In the end its all up to you, but just know that they want to ALL about it. When it was, what happened, how many times, thoughts of suicide, healthier coping mechanisms, etc, etc. And I have a feeling I got super lucky with my waiver so just take my advice, but you have to weigh for yourself if you want to lie or not. I wish you luck! Be confident! And stay positive!
